notes.title: Last update: beta1.2.1
notes.notes:
Sorry, the author disappeared for such a year because of various reasons (unable to log in to steamworks, psychological problems, etc.).

[h3]This update: [/h3]
——Because there was a problem in the production team before (an outsider was recruited and made a mess), the previous levels could not be played normally, which has been repaired;
——Fixed some bugs;
——Remove the herobrine;
[h3] That's almost all. This update just does some simple work. It clears up the mess in the past and makes the game play normally. [/h3]

[h1]————————————[/h1]

[h3] The previous announcement said that the game was going to undergo major changes, and the author also made a partial reset truthfully, but because the changes were too big (it can be said that a new game was made), it was split into two games, the old CSC and the new CSC (plus version). [/h3]
[h2] The plus version will be released separately, which is why this update is the last version. Next, the author will make this game free, and players who have purchased the old version will get a discount when purchasing the new version. [/h2]
The author has only one person to develop, with less and less energy, more and more trivial matters and slow progress.

[h3] Link to the demo video of the reset version under development: [/h3]
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1KN4y1w7f6/?spm_id_from=333.999.0.0&vd_source=731a05da5d99bc475b401d39dbfea23a

notes.title: Game change
notes.notes:
Because the we is very dissatisfied with the effect of the current game, we has to make a big change, of course, on the premise that the save can be opened.

The contents to be changed at this stage are as follows:

——The story and the plot have to be changed.
——The animation of fighting will be more detailed and may be closer to act.
——The dialogue system needs to be redone. It is no longer the original dialogue interface like GALGAME.
——Filing on the way or something.
——Character sketch reset.
——Reset the main interface.
——Change the UI.

——If you can, online mode may be added later in the future.
That's about it. If there's no problem, change it according to the announcement.
I'm sorry that I haven't updated it for such a long time. After all, the author has been drawing comics for some time

notes.title: Update: beta1.1
notes.notes:
Long time no see. I'm back~
Although it took so long, I didn't do much. After all, many things happened in my life.
Here is the update:

——Level1 and level2 have been redone, so they can't play.
——Added the fall action, if knocked down, it will continue to attack, players can also knock down the monster.
——The death effect has been added (although it has been done for a long time). Players can better distinguish dead monsters from fallen monsters.

——Changed the attack rhythm of some characters.
——Changed Ritmo's standing movement.
——Changed the cover when entering the game.

——Encyclopedia has been added, which can be found in the main menu and can be consulted by players to better understand the world outlook (highly recommended)
Although the encyclopedia, but are in Chinese, foreign players may have to wait.
——Some bugs have been fixed (although the author has forgotten which).

I'm going to change the posters and promotional videos of the game. Now these are really bad.
All in all, have a good time~

notes.title: Update: beta1.0.6
notes.notes:
I've been cooing for a long time, and now school is starting. I just finished some things. Here's the update:

——Fixed 慧里安 AI bug. 慧里安's AI is still normal in Easy mode.
——It's a skill of 慧里安.
——The knockback algorithm has been modified. The higher the target's health and defense, the less likely it is to be knocked back.
——Some new monsters have been added.
——In the preface and the first chapter of the plug novice teaching, so that new players better start.
——Modify and optimize the attack code, although the actual feel of the player has not changed.

In short, more content on the above so much, have a good time~
